qualification: Pinned executable bytes establish 54 style-three records of four signed DWORDs. Existing pyramid image data owns each first pair; the provider sign-extends it, duplicates equal main-part pairs, then applies the fourteen records whose second pair differs. Regular offsets and nine main-part pairs are sign-extended from the same qualified initial data.
limitations: Data-provider initialization has no standalone native entry and therefore no function-map address.
